# telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_profile (Resource)

The WhatsApp business profile of a phone number, the description, address, website and contact details WhatsApp users see. Creating this resource adopts the profile of an existing number; destroying it leaves the profile as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Destroy leaves the profile as it is.
resource "telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_profile" "support" {
  phone_number = telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number.support.phone_number
  display_name = "Acme Support"
  about        = "Order help, seven days a week."
  description  = "Acme sells home goods online. Message us about orders, returns and deliveries."
  email        = "support@acme.example.com"
  website      = "https://acme.example.com"
  address      = "600 Congress Avenue, Austin, TX 78701"
  profile_id   = telnyx_messaging_profile.support.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `phone_number` (String) The phone number.

### Optional

- `about` (String) The business's About text, at most 139 characters.
- `address` (String) The business's address.
- `category` (String) The business category (vertical) shown on the profile.
- `description` (String) Description of the business, at most 512 characters.
- `display_name` (String) The business name shown on the profile.
- `email` (String) The business's contact email address.
- `profile_id` (String) Messaging profile ID for inbound messages
- `website` (String) The business's website URL.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `phone_number_id` (String) Whatsapp phone number ID
- `profile_photo_url` (String) URL of the profile photo. Set the photo with the telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_profile_photo_upload action.
- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_profile.support <phone_number>
```
